title: How the desktop consumes OilandGasTools

probe.question: Are the 13 TheTechIdea.OilGas.* packages published or available in a local feed?
probe.nugetOrg: 404 for all 13 package ids (wellbore, wellbore.data, wellbore.loaders, wellschematic, welllogs, mapping, integrity, drilling, production, training, dataai, configtool, wellbore.setup)

decision: ProjectReference into the sibling checkout, with the root exposed as the OilGasToolsRoot property (default ..\..\..\OilandGasTools). A missing checkout fails the build with an explicit message.
consequences: The desktop build requires the OilandGasTools checkout; the error message names the property to set.
The tools' MinVer runs during our build and needs git on PATH. When git is unavailable, build with -p:SkipMinVer=true; versioning of the tools checkout is its own repository's concern.
SkiaSharp is pinned to 4.154.0 (ADR-001) at the desktop level, overriding the tools' 4.150.1.
verifiedBy: dotnet build src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.slnx -c Debug -p:SkipMinVer=true → 0 warnings / 0 errors, including the WellTools project that references TheTechIdea.OilGas.Wellbore
